contract.validation: Exact migration-backed OpenAPI/runtime fields; submitted-only lifecycle; source bounds and decimal precision; location/page binding; exact row count and continuation; unique signal IDs; updated_at DESC, id DESC ordering; continuation stops at the Gateway's 10,000-offset ceiling; no narrative, creator, receipt, or reviewer identity is exposed.
contract.authorization: Existing operating_pilot:review exact-location grant and signed tenant context are unchanged.

verification.ruff_default: passed on changed source and tests
verification.fixture_update: Updated the prior route fixture to include the complete migration-defined page fields required by the new strict response contract.

rollback: Revert the Gateway source, focused tests, and refactor progress/evidence updates; no database rollback is needed.
